GeneratedReport.title: Generated Report
GeneratedReport.description: A report produced under Reporting & Compliance and stored as a file in Nextcloud. Records what was generated, for which period/administration, in which format, where the file lives, and the system tags applied so it is retrievable from the generated-reports index.

reportType.description: ReportCatalogue report-type id (e.g. vat-return, trial-balance, annual-accounts).
reportType.title: Report Type

reportLabel.description: Human label of the report type at generation time.
reportLabel.title: Report Label

category.description: ReportCatalogue category id (tax, statements, ledger, audit-file, public-sector, compliance).
category.title: Category

administrationId.description: Administration the report was generated for.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

format.description: File format: pdf | odt | xlsx | csv | xml | xbrl | json (document-kind reports render as pdf/odt via docudesk; docx is not produced).
format.title: Format

filePath.description: Nextcloud path of the stored file (e.g. /Shillinq/Reports/...).
filePath.title: File Path

fileId.description: Nextcloud file id of the stored file (for download/deep-link).
fileId.title: File ID

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the report was generated.
generatedAt.title: Generated At

generatedBy.description: User id that generated the report.
generatedBy.title: Generated By

status.description: Generation status. 'unavailable' means the render step could not run because its renderer (docudesk, for document-kind reports) was not installed/reachable -- a visible, retryable outcome, distinct from 'failed' (REQ-RVD-005, ADR-081 rule 7).
status.title: Status

tags.description: System tags applied to the file for retrieval (report type, period, administration, category).
tags.title: Tags

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Generated Report is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.
